title: The many interfaces of neurotechnology
abstract: At the heart of neurotechnology are interactions between brains and machines, users and devices, and basic and translational science. The contributions in this issue show how these interfaces are driving both technology and new discoveries about the nervous system.
abstract_zh: 神经技术的核心是大脑与机器、用户与设备以及基础与转化科学之间的相互作用。本期文章展示了这些接口如何推动技术进步和对神经系统的新发现。
